# 24hour pain pattern

Pain upon waking that improves with movement could be indicative of lymphatic dysfunction @FCSLV2.
Lymphatics arent working throughout the night and the limited movement causes buildup of inflammation. Once the muscles activate and begin moving, lymphatic function improves due to the external forces and pain improves @FCSLV2
